description: This file defines the LeaveAPI class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the Leave plugin's API namespace. It implements RESTful endpoints for managing leave-related operations such as listing leaves in a leave request and updating the status of individual leave entries. The class utilizes traits for common functionalities, performs validation, handles HTTP request parameters, and interacts with the domain models and data access objects related to leave requests and leaves.

classes.name: LeaveAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class managing leave-related operations within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. Implements CRUD endpoints, validation, and business logic for listing leaves of a request and updating leave statuses.

methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all leaves associated with a specific leave request, including validation, access checks, and formatting of the response.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing leaves, including filtering by leave request ID and pagination.
